## ✅ Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and fixed any issues
- [ ] I have run `npm run typecheck` and fixed any issues

### Testing

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`npm test`)
- [ ] I have tested my changes in multiple browsers (if applicable)
- [ ] I have tested keyboard navigation and accessibility

### Documentation

- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable)
- [ ] I have added/updated the Kitchen Sink demo (for new components or features)
- [ ] I have updated CHANGELOG.md with my changes

### Component-Specific (if applicable)

- [ ] Component follows DOS aesthetic (no rounded corners, monospace fonts, etc.)
- [ ] Component has proper ARIA attributes
- [ ] Component has proper keyboard navigation
- [ ] Component works with all theme presets
- [ ] Component has comprehensive JSDoc comments
